points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report.tex:87–103,155–158 claims 100-step short test residual 1.5→8.5, Cd≈0.11, Cl≈0. Its own accepted PDF pp2–3 shows residual >10^13 by step 69 and Cd≈-455, Cl≈403. results/final_verify is 8-rank, failed and NaN after step 69; surface Cp plot is empty because data are NaN. Broader divergence is acknowledged.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Short-test narrative conflicts with delivered figure and failed 8-rank results/final_verify; plotted finite values match that diagnostic scale but unique exact source not established. Canonical case packages and short test differ.
